programme.title: The Professor & The Madman
programme.desc: Based on the best-selling novel by Simon Winchester, The Professor and the Madman is an extraordinary true tale of genius and obsession about two remarkable men - one an Oxford professor and the other, an inmate at Broadmoor Criminal Lunatic Asylum - who created history with the writing of the Oxford English Dictionary. Stars Mel Gibson, Sean Penn and Natalie Dormer.

programme.title: La Maison
programme.desc: 27-year-old French writer Emma immerses herself in Berlin's sex trade to research her novel. What begins as brief research becomes a two-year journey of desire, danger, and discovery.

programme.title: The Fence
programme.desc: Motorbikes, fast cars, punch-ups and 80's music. Set on the streets of 1980s Bristol, this retro flick follows a council estate kid out to settle the score with local thieves.

programme.title: The Silver Brumby
programme.desc: During a violent storm in the Victorian Highlands, a mother tells her frightened daughter a fable about a great silver brumby who must find its place among its kind, while one man, living in the wilderness, is determined to capture the brumby and tame it. Directed by John Tatoulis and stars Russell Crowe and Caroline Goodall.

programme.title: A River Runs Through It
programme.desc: The Maclean brothers, Paul (Brad Pitt) and Norman (Craig Sheffer), live a relatively idyllic life in rural Montana, spending much of their time fly fishing. The sons of a minister (Tom Skerritt), the boys eventually part company when Norman moves east to attend college, leaving his rebellious brother to find trouble back home. When Norman finally returns, the siblings resume their fishing outings, and assess both where they've been and where they're going.

programme.title: The Fisher King
programme.desc: Jeff Bridges stars as Jack Lucas, a former radio shock-jock who sinks into a boozy depression when his flip comment on the air is blamed for a shooting spree in an upscale cafe. Living off the kindness of long-suffering girlfriend Anne (Mercedes Ruehl), Jack has an epiphany when he is rescued from street punks by Parry (Robin Williams), a homeless former professor who has created a world of his own invention to insulate himself from the pain of witnessing his wife's death, in the cafe shooting spree. Directed by Terry Gilliam (Brazil).

programme.title: Only the Brave
programme.desc: Only the Brave tells the true story of the Granite Mountain Hotshots, a fearless team of firefighters who risk everything to protect others, forging a deep brotherhood tested by a deadly wildfire.

programme.title: The Ploughman's Lunch
programme.desc: James Penfield (Jonathan Pryce) has made a career out of journalism. Now bankrupt, he finds himself with a group of other writers in the middle of the dispute-ridden British homeland at the time of the Falklands War.

programme.title: The Amazing Mr. Blunden
programme.desc: In 1918, war widow Mrs. Allen and her children leave their cramped London flat to care for the derelict, allegedly haunted Langley Park, a country mansion awaiting its rightful heirs.

programme.title: Jumanji
programme.desc: Robin Williams and Kirsten Dunst star in this blockbuster hit and critical favourite that combines magical special effects with an entrancing mix of fantasy, adventure and comedy. Young Alan Parrish sits down as a young boy to play a game with his friend, Sarah, and on a roll of the dice is mysteriously transported into the strange jungle realm of Jumanji. There he remains trapped for 26 years, until two newly orphaned children, Judy (Dunst) and Peter (Bradley Pierce), playing in the attic of Alan’s childhood home, free the now-adult Alan (Williams) from the game’s clutches. But to defeat Jumanji’s encroaching powers, the three reluctant players must find the now-grown Sarah (Bonnie Hunt) and band together as a makeshift family to finish the game--before it finishes them.

programme.title: Gone Girl
programme.desc: On the occasion of his fifth wedding anniversary, Nick Dunne reports that his wife, Amy, has gone missing. Under pressure from the police and a growing media frenzy, Nick's portrait of a blissful union begins to crumble. Soon his lies, deceits and strange behaviour have everyone asking the same dark question: Did Nick Dunne kill his wife? Directed by David Fincher and stars Ben Affleck, Rosamund Pike and Neil Patrick Harris.

programme.title: The Little Death
programme.desc: Unfulfilled suburban couples try to spice up their sex lives by exploring various fetishes.

programme.title: Cheese Slices
programme.desc: After more than a decade, Will Studd returns to the Pyrenees Mountains, home to some of the world's oldest shepherd's cheeses and one of the last strongholds of traditional artisan cheese making in Western Europe. Beginning his journey in the Basque region of Spain, Will introduces his daughter Ellie to cheese maker Peio Etxeleku of Agour dairy. Peio shows off his new cheese facility in the Iraty Valley and discusses the many challenges now facing the regions traditional Cheesemakers.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.sub-title: Sausage Egg & Cheese All Day Long
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde brings out the best of brunch with sweet and savoury hits such as bacon wrapped dates stuffed with chorizo, maple sausage, egg, and cheese fried rice and BBQ duck, egg, and corn scallion pancake sandwiches.

programme.title: Flat Out Food
programme.desc: Jenn learns how ethically sourced coffee makes its way to Saskatchewan and explores the processes of roasting, cupping, and using coffee beyond brewing the perfect cup of joe.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail
programme.sub-title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail Series 1 Ep 3
programme.desc: Escaping the hustle and bustle of Sydney, Luke visits the Blue Mountains in New South Wales. Overlooking the majestic ranges, Luke cooks seared Lamb Cutlets with an Asian Salsa Verde, and meets up with his old friend Huong to have an Eastern high tea. Utilising the local produce, Luke cooks a pan seared Quail at Echoes Restaurant. He meets with the top chefs from the area and discovers their signature dishes.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail
programme.sub-title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail Series 1 Ep 4
programme.desc: On the sunshine coast of Australia, Luke meets with a local fisherman to learn about where his produce comes from and they go out netting for Spanner Crabs. Inspired by his newfound knowledge of Spanner Crabs, Luke mixes a Spanner crab with pomelo salad. Then, with the executive chef at the Spirit House, Luke cooks grilled kingfish with a Thai influence.

programme.title: Kriol Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Maria Morgan: Ox Tail Stew & Vegie Bake
programme.desc: Marie Morgan draws on the Kimberley history of station and mission days. Marie shares with us a family recipe that takes us back to a simpler time.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.desc: Rachael puts an Italian spin on the classic French dip, marinating steak in bold Italian seasonings for a warm, comforting sandwich perfect for cooler days.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen

programme.desc: It's important to Lidia to be inclusive at the dinner table, and cook dishes that meet the dietary restrictions of all- from vegetarian to gluten-free.

programme.desc: First up, Simon wraps tabbouleh with tempeh for toothsome flavours and then bakes an avocado that's cheesy and creamy. Rebecca Veale from Humble Jumble is also in the kitchen today to make her famous sticky date pudding.

programme.title: Food Safari Earth
programme.desc: Maeve explores the sweet power of onions with Spanish chef, Pablo Tordesillas Garcia and discovers the delights of a Catalonian favourite - char-grilled baby leeks with romesco sauce. Sicilian-Australian chef, Rosa Mitchell recalls a symphony of recipes from her heritage in her Melbourne restaurant, Rosa's Canteen - and shares her version of caponata - a sweet-sour vegetable dish that epitomises what the Italians refer to as 'agrodolce'.

programme.desc: Rick Stein begins his Indian journey by exploring the regions that began Britain's love affair with curry - Bengal and Tamil Nadu. The British influence in Kolkata and Chennai remains strong to this day, and Rick enjoys the prominence of fish and seafood in so many of their dishes - dishes flavoured with mustard in Kolkata and tamarind in Chennai. Exploring the eating habits of these cities is the start of a fascinating trip for Rick who is inspired to cook dishes like prawns in coconut milk and his mum's version of British Raj curry.

When Norman finally returns, the siblings resume their fishing outings, and assess both where they've been and where they're going.

Living off the kindness of long-suffering girlfriend Anne (Mercedes Ruehl), Jack has an epiphany when he is rescued from street punks by Parry (Robin Williams), a homeless former professor who has created a world of his own invention to insulate himself from the pain of witnessing his wife's death, in the cafe shooting spree. Directed by Terry Gilliam (Brazil).

programme.title: The Professor & The Madman
programme.desc: Based on the best-selling novel by Simon Winchester, The Professor and the Madman is an extraordinary true tale of genius and obsession about two remarkable men - one an Oxford professor and the other, an inmate at Broadmoor Criminal Lunatic Asylum - who created history with the writing of the Oxford English Dictionary. Stars Mel Gibson, Sean Penn and Natalie Dormer.

programme.title: La Maison
programme.desc: 27-year-old French writer Emma immerses herself in Berlin's sex trade to research her novel. What begins as brief research becomes a two-year journey of desire, danger, and discovery.

programme.title: The Fence
programme.desc: Motorbikes, fast cars, punch-ups and 80's music. Set on the streets of 1980s Bristol, this retro flick follows a council estate kid out to settle the score with local thieves.

programme.title: The Silver Brumby
programme.desc: During a violent storm in the Victorian Highlands, a mother tells her frightened daughter a fable about a great silver brumby who must find its place among its kind, while one man, living in the wilderness, is determined to capture the brumby and tame it. Directed by John Tatoulis and stars Russell Crowe and Caroline Goodall.

programme.title: A River Runs Through It
programme.desc: The Maclean brothers, Paul (Brad Pitt) and Norman (Craig Sheffer), live a relatively idyllic life in rural Montana, spending much of their time fly fishing. The sons of a minister (Tom Skerritt), the boys eventually part company when Norman moves east to attend college, leaving his rebellious brother to find trouble back home. When Norman finally returns, the siblings resume their fishing outings, and assess both where they've been and where they're going.

programme.title: The Fisher King
programme.desc: Jeff Bridges stars as Jack Lucas, a former radio shock-jock who sinks into a boozy depression when his flip comment on the air is blamed for a shooting spree in an upscale cafe. Living off the kindness of long-suffering girlfriend Anne (Mercedes Ruehl), Jack has an epiphany when he is rescued from street punks by Parry (Robin Williams), a homeless former professor who has created a world of his own invention to insulate himself from the pain of witnessing his wife's death, in the cafe shooting spree. Directed by Terry Gilliam (Brazil).

programme.title: Only the Brave
programme.desc: Only the Brave tells the true story of the Granite Mountain Hotshots, a fearless team of firefighters who risk everything to protect others, forging a deep brotherhood tested by a deadly wildfire.

programme.title: The Ploughman's Lunch
programme.desc: James Penfield (Jonathan Pryce) has made a career out of journalism. Now bankrupt, he finds himself with a group of other writers in the middle of the dispute-ridden British homeland at the time of the Falklands War.

programme.title: The Amazing Mr. Blunden
programme.desc: In 1918, war widow Mrs. Allen and her children leave their cramped London flat to care for the derelict, allegedly haunted Langley Park, a country mansion awaiting its rightful heirs.

programme.title: Jumanji
programme.desc: Robin Williams and Kirsten Dunst star in this blockbuster hit and critical favourite that combines magical special effects with an entrancing mix of fantasy, adventure and comedy. Young Alan Parrish sits down as a young boy to play a game with his friend, Sarah, and on a roll of the dice is mysteriously transported into the strange jungle realm of Jumanji. There he remains trapped for 26 years, until two newly orphaned children, Judy (Dunst) and Peter (Bradley Pierce), playing in the attic of Alan’s childhood home, free the now-adult Alan (Williams) from the game’s clutches. But to defeat Jumanji’s encroaching powers, the three reluctant players must find the now-grown Sarah (Bonnie Hunt) and band together as a makeshift family to finish the game--before it finishes them.

programme.title: Gone Girl
programme.desc: On the occasion of his fifth wedding anniversary, Nick Dunne reports that his wife, Amy, has gone missing. Under pressure from the police and a growing media frenzy, Nick's portrait of a blissful union begins to crumble. Soon his lies, deceits and strange behaviour have everyone asking the same dark question: Did Nick Dunne kill his wife? Directed by David Fincher and stars Ben Affleck, Rosamund Pike and Neil Patrick Harris.

programme.title: The Little Death
programme.desc: Unfulfilled suburban couples try to spice up their sex lives by exploring various fetishes.

programme.desc: After more than a decade, Will Studd returns to the Pyrenees Mountains, home to some of the world's oldest shepherd's cheeses and one of the last strongholds of traditional artisan cheese making in Western Europe. Beginning his journey in the Basque region of Spain, Will introduces his daughter Ellie to cheese maker Peio Etxeleku of Agour dairy. Peio shows off his new cheese facility in the Iraty Valley and discusses the many challenges now facing the regions traditional Cheesemakers.

Utilising the local produce, Luke cooks a pan seared Quail at Echoes Restaurant. He meets with the top chefs from the area and discovers their signature dishes.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail
programme.sub-title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail Series 1 Ep 4

Inspired by his newfound knowledge of Spanner Crabs, Luke mixes a Spanner crab with pomelo salad. Then, with the executive chef at the Spirit House, Luke cooks grilled kingfish with a Thai influence.

Exploring the eating habits of these cities is the start of a fascinating trip for Rick who is inspired to cook dishes like prawns in coconut milk and his mum's version of British Raj curry.

Stars Mel Gibson, Sean Penn and Natalie Dormer.

programme.title: La Maison
programme.desc: 27-year-old French writer Emma immerses herself in Berlin's sex trade to research her novel. What begins as brief research becomes a two-year journey of desire, danger, and discovery.

programme.title: The Fence
programme.desc: Motorbikes, fast cars, punch-ups and 80's music. Set on the streets of 1980s Bristol, this retro flick follows a council estate kid out to settle the score with local thieves.

programme.title: The Silver Brumby
programme.desc: During a violent storm in the Victorian Highlands, a mother tells her frightened daughter a fable about a great silver brumby who must find its place among its kind, while one man, living in the wilderness, is determined to capture the brumby and tame it. Directed by John Tatoulis and stars Russell Crowe and Caroline Goodall.

programme.title: A River Runs Through It
programme.desc: The Maclean brothers, Paul (Brad Pitt) and Norman (Craig Sheffer), live a relatively idyllic life in rural Montana, spending much of their time fly fishing. The sons of a minister (Tom Skerritt), the boys eventually part company when Norman moves east to attend college, leaving his rebellious brother to find trouble back home. When Norman finally returns, the siblings resume their fishing outings, and assess both where they've been and where they're going.

programme.title: The Fisher King
programme.desc: Jeff Bridges stars as Jack Lucas, a former radio shock-jock who sinks into a boozy depression when his flip comment on the air is blamed for a shooting spree in an upscale cafe. Living off the kindness of long-suffering girlfriend Anne (Mercedes Ruehl), Jack has an epiphany when he is rescued from street punks by Parry (Robin Williams), a homeless former professor who has created a world of his own invention to insulate himself from the pain of witnessing his wife's death, in the cafe shooting spree. Directed by Terry Gilliam (Brazil).

programme.title: Only the Brave
programme.desc: Only the Brave tells the true story of the Granite Mountain Hotshots, a fearless team of firefighters who risk everything to protect others, forging a deep brotherhood tested by a deadly wildfire.

programme.title: The Ploughman's Lunch
programme.desc: James Penfield (Jonathan Pryce) has made a career out of journalism. Now bankrupt, he finds himself with a group of other writers in the middle of the dispute-ridden British homeland at the time of the Falklands War.

programme.title: The Amazing Mr. Blunden
programme.desc: In 1918, war widow Mrs. Allen and her children leave their cramped London flat to care for the derelict, allegedly haunted Langley Park, a country mansion awaiting its rightful heirs.

programme.title: Jumanji
programme.desc: Robin Williams and Kirsten Dunst star in this blockbuster hit and critical favourite that combines magical special effects with an entrancing mix of fantasy, adventure and comedy. Young Alan Parrish sits down as a young boy to play a game with his friend, Sarah, and on a roll of the dice is mysteriously transported into the strange jungle realm of Jumanji. There he remains trapped for 26 years, until two newly orphaned children, Judy (Dunst) and Peter (Bradley Pierce), playing in the attic of Alan’s childhood home, free the now-adult Alan (Williams) from the game’s clutches. But to defeat Jumanji’s encroaching powers, the three reluctant players must find the now-grown Sarah (Bonnie Hunt) and band together as a makeshift family to finish the game--before it finishes them.

programme.title: Gone Girl
programme.desc: On the occasion of his fifth wedding anniversary, Nick Dunne reports that his wife, Amy, has gone missing. Under pressure from the police and a growing media frenzy, Nick's portrait of a blissful union begins to crumble. Soon his lies, deceits and strange behaviour have everyone asking the same dark question: Did Nick Dunne kill his wife? Directed by David Fincher and stars Ben Affleck, Rosamund Pike and Neil Patrick Harris.

Then, with the executive chef at the Spirit House, Luke cooks grilled kingfish with a Thai influence.

The British influence in Kolkata and Chennai remains strong to this day, and Rick enjoys the prominence of fish and seafood in so many of their dishes - dishes flavoured with mustard in Kolkata and tamarind in Chennai. Exploring the eating habits of these cities is the start of a fascinating trip for Rick who is inspired to cook dishes like prawns in coconut milk and his mum's version of British Raj curry.

programme.desc: Based on the best-selling novel by Simon Winchester, The Professor and the Madman is an extraordinary true tale of genius and obsession about two remarkable men - one an Oxford professor and the other, an inmate at Broadmoor Criminal Lunatic Asylum - who created history with the writing of the Oxford English Dictionary. Stars Mel Gibson, Sean Penn and Natalie Dormer.

programme.title: La Maison
programme.desc: 27-year-old French writer Emma immerses herself in Berlin's sex trade to research her novel. What begins as brief research becomes a two-year journey of desire, danger, and discovery.

programme.title: The Fence
programme.desc: Motorbikes, fast cars, punch-ups and 80's music. Set on the streets of 1980s Bristol, this retro flick follows a council estate kid out to settle the score with local thieves.

programme.title: The Silver Brumby
programme.desc: During a violent storm in the Victorian Highlands, a mother tells her frightened daughter a fable about a great silver brumby who must find its place among its kind, while one man, living in the wilderness, is determined to capture the brumby and tame it. Directed by John Tatoulis and stars Russell Crowe and Caroline Goodall.

programme.title: A River Runs Through It
programme.desc: The Maclean brothers, Paul (Brad Pitt) and Norman (Craig Sheffer), live a relatively idyllic life in rural Montana, spending much of their time fly fishing. The sons of a minister (Tom Skerritt), the boys eventually part company when Norman moves east to attend college, leaving his rebellious brother to find trouble back home. When Norman finally returns, the siblings resume their fishing outings, and assess both where they've been and where they're going.

programme.title: The Fisher King
programme.desc: Jeff Bridges stars as Jack Lucas, a former radio shock-jock who sinks into a boozy depression when his flip comment on the air is blamed for a shooting spree in an upscale cafe. Living off the kindness of long-suffering girlfriend Anne (Mercedes Ruehl), Jack has an epiphany when he is rescued from street punks by Parry (Robin Williams), a homeless former professor who has created a world of his own invention to insulate himself from the pain of witnessing his wife's death, in the cafe shooting spree. Directed by Terry Gilliam (Brazil).

programme.title: Only the Brave
programme.desc: Only the Brave tells the true story of the Granite Mountain Hotshots, a fearless team of firefighters who risk everything to protect others, forging a deep brotherhood tested by a deadly wildfire.

programme.title: The Ploughman's Lunch
programme.desc: James Penfield (Jonathan Pryce) has made a career out of journalism. Now bankrupt, he finds himself with a group of other writers in the middle of the dispute-ridden British homeland at the time of the Falklands War.

programme.title: The Amazing Mr. Blunden
programme.desc: In 1918, war widow Mrs. Allen and her children leave their cramped London flat to care for the derelict, allegedly haunted Langley Park, a country mansion awaiting its rightful heirs.

programme.title: Jumanji
programme.desc: Robin Williams and Kirsten Dunst star in this blockbuster hit and critical favourite that combines magical special effects with an entrancing mix of fantasy, adventure and comedy. Young Alan Parrish sits down as a young boy to play a game with his friend, Sarah, and on a roll of the dice is mysteriously transported into the strange jungle realm of Jumanji. There he remains trapped for 26 years, until two newly orphaned children, Judy (Dunst) and Peter (Bradley Pierce), playing in the attic of Alan’s childhood home, free the now-adult Alan (Williams) from the game’s clutches. But to defeat Jumanji’s encroaching powers, the three reluctant players must find the now-grown Sarah (Bonnie Hunt) and band together as a makeshift family to finish the game--before it finishes them.

programme.title: Gone Girl
programme.desc: On the occasion of his fifth wedding anniversary, Nick Dunne reports that his wife, Amy, has gone missing. Under pressure from the police and a growing media frenzy, Nick's portrait of a blissful union begins to crumble. Soon his lies, deceits and strange behaviour have everyone asking the same dark question: Did Nick Dunne kill his wife? Directed by David Fincher and stars Ben Affleck, Rosamund Pike and Neil Patrick Harris.

Beginning his journey in the Basque region of Spain, Will introduces his daughter Ellie to cheese maker Peio Etxeleku of Agour dairy. Peio shows off his new cheese facility in the Iraty Valley and discusses the many challenges now facing the regions traditional Cheesemakers.

Utilising the local produce, Luke cooks a pan seared Quail at Echoes Restaurant. He meets with the top chefs from the area and discovers their signature dishes.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail
programme.sub-title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail Series 1 Ep 4

Inspired by his newfound knowledge of Spanner Crabs, Luke mixes a Spanner crab with pomelo salad. Then, with the executive chef at the Spirit House, Luke cooks grilled kingfish with a Thai influence.

programme.desc: The Maclean brothers, Paul (Brad Pitt) and Norman (Craig Sheffer), live a relatively idyllic life in rural Montana, spending much of their time fly fishing. The sons of a minister (Tom Skerritt), the boys eventually part company when Norman moves east to attend college, leaving his rebellious brother to find trouble back home. When Norman finally returns, the siblings resume their fishing outings, and assess both where they've been and where they're going.

programme.title: The Fisher King
programme.desc: Jeff Bridges stars as Jack Lucas, a former radio shock-jock who sinks into a boozy depression when his flip comment on the air is blamed for a shooting spree in an upscale cafe. Living off the kindness of long-suffering girlfriend Anne (Mercedes Ruehl), Jack has an epiphany when he is rescued from street punks by Parry (Robin Williams), a homeless former professor who has created a world of his own invention to insulate himself from the pain of witnessing his wife's death, in the cafe shooting spree. Directed by Terry Gilliam (Brazil).

Young Alan Parrish sits down as a young boy to play a game with his friend, Sarah, and on a roll of the dice is mysteriously transported into the strange jungle realm of Jumanji. There he remains trapped for 26 years, until two newly orphaned children, Judy (Dunst) and Peter (Bradley Pierce), playing in the attic of Alan’s childhood home, free the now-adult Alan (Williams) from the game’s clutches. But to defeat Jumanji’s encroaching powers, the three reluctant players must find the now-grown Sarah (Bonnie Hunt) and band together as a makeshift family to finish the game--before it finishes them.

Under pressure from the police and a growing media frenzy, Nick's portrait of a blissful union begins to crumble. Directed by John Tatoulis and stars Russell Crowe and Caroline Goodall.

programme.title: A River Runs Through It
programme.desc: The Maclean brothers, Paul (Brad Pitt) and Norman (Craig Sheffer), live a relatively idyllic life in rural Montana, spending much of their time fly fishing. The sons of a minister (Tom Skerritt), the boys eventually part company when Norman moves east to attend college, leaving his rebellious brother to find trouble back home. When Norman finally returns, the siblings resume their fishing outings, and assess both where they've been and where they're going.

programme.title: The Fisher King
programme.desc: Jeff Bridges stars as Jack Lucas, a former radio shock-jock who sinks into a boozy depression when his flip comment on the air is blamed for a shooting spree in an upscale cafe. Living off the kindness of long-suffering girlfriend Anne (Mercedes Ruehl), Jack has an epiphany when he is rescued from street punks by Parry (Robin Williams), a homeless former professor who has created a world of his own invention to insulate himself from the pain of witnessing his wife's death, in the cafe shooting spree. Directed by Terry Gilliam (Brazil).

programme.title: Only the Brave

programme.title: Jumanji
programme.desc: Robin Williams and Kirsten Dunst star in this blockbuster hit and critical favourite that combines magical special effects with an entrancing mix of fantasy, adventure and comedy. Young Alan Parrish sits down as a young boy to play a game with his friend, Sarah, and on a roll of the dice is mysteriously transported into the strange jungle realm of Jumanji. There he remains trapped for 26 years, until two newly orphaned children, Judy (Dunst) and Peter (Bradley Pierce), playing in the attic of Alan’s childhood home, free the now-adult Alan (Williams) from the game’s clutches. But to defeat Jumanji’s encroaching powers, the three reluctant players must find the now-grown Sarah (Bonnie Hunt) and band together as a makeshift family to finish the game--before it finishes them.

Directed by David Fincher and stars Ben Affleck, Rosamund Pike and Neil Patrick Harris.

programme.title: The Truth About Anxiety: Celia Pacquola

programme.title: The World From Above
programme.desc: With mountains and lakes carved out by glaciers during the last ice age, the Lake District is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and boasts some of the finest scenery in Europe. Our journey begins at Wastwater, the deepest lake in England, and Scafell Pike, England's highest mountain. Exploring some of the central mountains or 'fells', we head via Coniston to Windermere, England's largest natural lake.

programme.title: Following The Flow
programme.desc: In February 2020 there was only one word on people's lips West of the Great Divide - water. Following the Flow tells the story of the once-mighty Macquarie Wambool River in inland New South Wales right as the 'worst drought on record' was finally breaking. See the Macquarie River through the eyes of the people that know it best - First Nations peoples, historians, ecologists, water managers, farmers and fishers all with a story to tell.

programme.title: Grand Tours Of Scotland's Rivers
programme.sub-title: From The Trossachs To The Kelpies
programme.desc: This Grand Tour follows the River Forth from the eastern slopes of Ben Lomond in the southern highlands, through the picturesque Trossachs, to the Firth of Forth. On the way, Paul walks in the footsteps of outlaw and folk hero Rob Roy.

programme.title: Grand Tours Of Scotland's Rivers
programme.desc: Paul explores the River Oykel in Sutherland from its source in Assynt, to the Dornoch Firth and the sea. He learns about the loneliest and highest war grave in Scotland.

programme.title: Tour De France 2026 Pm Highlights
programme.desc: Evening highlights from Stage 19 of the 2026 Tour de France, as the peloton takes on a 128 km route starting in Gap and finishing in Alpe d'Huez.

programme.desc: All the action from Stage 20 of the 2026 Tour de France, as the peloton takes on a 171 km route starting in Le Bourg d'Oisans and finishing in Alpe d'Huez.

programme.title: The Professor & The Madman
programme.desc: Based on the best-selling novel by Simon Winchester, The Professor and the Madman is an extraordinary true tale of genius and obsession about two remarkable men - one an Oxford professor and the other, an inmate at Broadmoor Criminal Lunatic Asylum - who created history with the writing of the Oxford English Dictionary. Stars Mel Gibson, Sean Penn and Natalie Dormer.

programme.title: La Maison
programme.desc: 27-year-old French writer Emma immerses herself in Berlin's sex trade to research her novel. What begins as brief research becomes a two-year journey of desire, danger, and discovery.

programme.title: The Fence
programme.desc: Motorbikes, fast cars, punch-ups and 80's music. Set on the streets of 1980s Bristol, this retro flick follows a council estate kid out to settle the score with local thieves.

programme.title: The Silver Brumby
programme.desc: During a violent storm in the Victorian Highlands, a mother tells her frightened daughter a fable about a great silver brumby who must find its place among its kind, while one man, living in the wilderness, is determined to capture the brumby and tame it. Directed by John Tatoulis and stars Russell Crowe and Caroline Goodall.

programme.title: A River Runs Through It
programme.desc: The Maclean brothers, Paul (Brad Pitt) and Norman (Craig Sheffer), live a relatively idyllic life in rural Montana, spending much of their time fly fishing. The sons of a minister (Tom Skerritt), the boys eventually part company when Norman moves east to attend college, leaving his rebellious brother to find trouble back home. When Norman finally returns, the siblings resume their fishing outings, and assess both where they've been and where they're going.

programme.title: The Fisher King
programme.desc: Jeff Bridges stars as Jack Lucas, a former radio shock-jock who sinks into a boozy depression when his flip comment on the air is blamed for a shooting spree in an upscale cafe. Living off the kindness of long-suffering girlfriend Anne (Mercedes Ruehl), Jack has an epiphany when he is rescued from street punks by Parry (Robin Williams), a homeless former professor who has created a world of his own invention to insulate himself from the pain of witnessing his wife's death, in the cafe shooting spree. Directed by Terry Gilliam (Brazil).

programme.title: Only the Brave
programme.desc: Only the Brave tells the true story of the Granite Mountain Hotshots, a fearless team of firefighters who risk everything to protect others, forging a deep brotherhood tested by a deadly wildfire.

programme.title: The Ploughman's Lunch
programme.desc: James Penfield (Jonathan Pryce) has made a career out of journalism. Now bankrupt, he finds himself with a group of other writers in the middle of the dispute-ridden British homeland at the time of the Falklands War.

programme.title: The Amazing Mr. Blunden
programme.desc: In 1918, war widow Mrs. Allen and her children leave their cramped London flat to care for the derelict, allegedly haunted Langley Park, a country mansion awaiting its rightful heirs.

programme.title: Jumanji
programme.desc: Robin Williams and Kirsten Dunst star in this blockbuster hit and critical favourite that combines magical special effects with an entrancing mix of fantasy, adventure and comedy. Young Alan Parrish sits down as a young boy to play a game with his friend, Sarah, and on a roll of the dice is mysteriously transported into the strange jungle realm of Jumanji. There he remains trapped for 26 years, until two newly orphaned children, Judy (Dunst) and Peter (Bradley Pierce), playing in the attic of Alan’s childhood home, free the now-adult Alan (Williams) from the game’s clutches. But to defeat Jumanji’s encroaching powers, the three reluctant players must find the now-grown Sarah (Bonnie Hunt) and band together as a makeshift family to finish the game--before it finishes them.

programme.title: Gone Girl
programme.desc: On the occasion of his fifth wedding anniversary, Nick Dunne reports that his wife, Amy, has gone missing. Under pressure from the police and a growing media frenzy, Nick's portrait of a blissful union begins to crumble. Soon his lies, deceits and strange behaviour have everyone asking the same dark question: Did Nick Dunne kill his wife? Directed by David Fincher and stars Ben Affleck, Rosamund Pike and Neil Patrick Harris.

programme.title: The Little Death
programme.desc: Unfulfilled suburban couples try to spice up their sex lives by exploring various fetishes.

programme.title: Destination Flavour Scandinavia Bitesize
programme.sub-title: Destination Flavour Scandinavia Bitesize Series 1 Ep 5
programme.desc: Join Adam Liaw as he revisits the highlights from his Scandinavian food adventures.

programme.title: No Taste Like Home
programme.desc: Awkwafina lost her mom when she was very young. Antoni curates a culinary voyage of discovery to help her reconnect with her mother's Korean heritage.

programme.title: La Dolce Vita
programme.desc: Master pastry chefs Paco and Jacob Torreblanca travel around Spain, a country where sweets have been closely linked to religious festivities.

programme.title: Come Dine With Me UK
programme.desc: Our final host of the competition in Manchester is professional crooner Danny.

programme.title: Come Dine With Me UK
programme.desc: This week's competition is in Bedford & Cambridgeshire, where first to host is teaching assistant Michelle.

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programme.desc: What pasta recipes do Adam and his guests, pastry prince Adriano Zumbo and comedy queen Alex Ward, come back to again and again? Find out as they make their forever pastas.

programme.title: Cheese Slices
programme.desc: After more than a decade, Will Studd returns to the Pyrenees Mountains, home to some of the world's oldest shepherd's cheeses and one of the last strongholds of traditional artisan cheese making in Western Europe. Beginning his journey in the Basque region of Spain, Will introduces his daughter Ellie to cheese maker Peio Etxeleku of Agour dairy. Peio shows off his new cheese facility in the Iraty Valley and discusses the many challenges now facing the regions traditional Cheesemakers.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.sub-title: Sausage Egg & Cheese All Day Long
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde brings out the best of brunch with sweet and savoury hits such as bacon wrapped dates stuffed with chorizo, maple sausage, egg, and cheese fried rice and BBQ duck, egg, and corn scallion pancake sandwiches.

programme.title: Flat Out Food
programme.desc: Jenn learns how ethically sourced coffee makes its way to Saskatchewan and explores the processes of roasting, cupping, and using coffee beyond brewing the perfect cup of joe.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail
programme.sub-title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail Series 1 Ep 3
programme.desc: Escaping the hustle and bustle of Sydney, Luke visits the Blue Mountains in New South Wales. Overlooking the majestic ranges, Luke cooks seared Lamb Cutlets with an Asian Salsa Verde, and meets up with his old friend Huong to have an Eastern high tea. Utilising the local produce, Luke cooks a pan seared Quail at Echoes Restaurant. He meets with the top chefs from the area and discovers their signature dishes.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail
programme.sub-title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail Series 1 Ep 4
programme.desc: On the sunshine coast of Australia, Luke meets with a local fisherman to learn about where his produce comes from and they go out netting for Spanner Crabs. Inspired by his newfound knowledge of Spanner Crabs, Luke mixes a Spanner crab with pomelo salad. Then, with the executive chef at the Spirit House, Luke cooks grilled kingfish with a Thai influence.

programme.title: Kriol Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Maria Morgan: Ox Tail Stew & Vegie Bake
programme.desc: Marie Morgan draws on the Kimberley history of station and mission days. Marie shares with us a family recipe that takes us back to a simpler time.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.desc: Rachael puts an Italian spin on the classic French dip, marinating steak in bold Italian seasonings for a warm, comforting sandwich perfect for cooler days.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: Laura is joined in the Market Kitchen by vegetable farmer Catherine Velisha as they pickle celery, probably the most underrated pickle. Mike then cooks a beautiful vegetarian dish, Fried Tofu with Bang Bang Sauce, an ideal mid-week meal. To wrap the show, Laura makes and shares her popular Sausage Rolls.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: It's important to Lidia to be inclusive at the dinner table, and cook dishes that meet the dietary restrictions of all- from vegetarian to gluten-free.

programme.desc: First up, Simon wraps tabbouleh with tempeh for toothsome flavours and then bakes an avocado that's cheesy and creamy. Rebecca Veale from Humble Jumble is also in the kitchen today to make her famous sticky date pudding.

programme.title: Food Safari Earth
programme.desc: Maeve explores the sweet power of onions with Spanish chef, Pablo Tordesillas Garcia and discovers the delights of a Catalonian favourite - char-grilled baby leeks with romesco sauce. Sicilian-Australian chef, Rosa Mitchell recalls a symphony of recipes from her heritage in her Melbourne restaurant, Rosa's Canteen - and shares her version of caponata - a sweet-sour vegetable dish that epitomises what the Italians refer to as 'agrodolce'.

Exploring the eating habits of these cities is the start of a fascinating trip for Rick who is inspired to cook dishes like prawns in coconut milk and his mum's version of British Raj curry.

Stars Mel Gibson, Sean Penn and Natalie Dormer.

programme.title: La Maison
programme.desc: 27-year-old French writer Emma immerses herself in Berlin's sex trade to research her novel. What begins as brief research becomes a two-year journey of desire, danger, and discovery.

programme.title: The Fence
programme.desc: Motorbikes, fast cars, punch-ups and 80's music. Set on the streets of 1980s Bristol, this retro flick follows a council estate kid out to settle the score with local thieves.

programme.title: The Silver Brumby
programme.desc: During a violent storm in the Victorian Highlands, a mother tells her frightened daughter a fable about a great silver brumby who must find its place among its kind, while one man, living in the wilderness, is determined to capture the brumby and tame it. Directed by John Tatoulis and stars Russell Crowe and Caroline Goodall.

programme.title: A River Runs Through It
programme.desc: The Maclean brothers, Paul (Brad Pitt) and Norman (Craig Sheffer), live a relatively idyllic life in rural Montana, spending much of their time fly fishing. The sons of a minister (Tom Skerritt), the boys eventually part company when Norman moves east to attend college, leaving his rebellious brother to find trouble back home. When Norman finally returns, the siblings resume their fishing outings, and assess both where they've been and where they're going.

programme.title: The Fisher King
programme.desc: Jeff Bridges stars as Jack Lucas, a former radio shock-jock who sinks into a boozy depression when his flip comment on the air is blamed for a shooting spree in an upscale cafe. Living off the kindness of long-suffering girlfriend Anne (Mercedes Ruehl), Jack has an epiphany when he is rescued from street punks by Parry (Robin Williams), a homeless former professor who has created a world of his own invention to insulate himself from the pain of witnessing his wife's death, in the cafe shooting spree. Directed by Terry Gilliam (Brazil).

programme.title: Only the Brave
programme.desc: Only the Brave tells the true story of the Granite Mountain Hotshots, a fearless team of firefighters who risk everything to protect others, forging a deep brotherhood tested by a deadly wildfire.

programme.title: The Ploughman's Lunch

programme.title: The Amazing Mr. Blunden

programme.title: Jumanji
programme.desc: Robin Williams and Kirsten Dunst star in this blockbuster hit and critical favourite that combines magical special effects with an entrancing mix of fantasy, adventure and comedy. Young Alan Parrish sits down as a young boy to play a game with his friend, Sarah, and on a roll of the dice is mysteriously transported into the strange jungle realm of Jumanji. There he remains trapped for 26 years, until two newly orphaned children, Judy (Dunst) and Peter (Bradley Pierce), playing in the attic of Alan’s childhood home, free the now-adult Alan (Williams) from the game’s clutches. But to defeat Jumanji’s encroaching powers, the three reluctant players must find the now-grown Sarah (Bonnie Hunt) and band together as a makeshift family to finish the game--before it finishes them.

Under pressure from the police and a growing media frenzy, Nick's portrait of a blissful union begins to crumble. Soon his lies, deceits and strange behaviour have everyone asking the same dark question: Did Nick Dunne kill his wife? Directed by David Fincher and stars Ben Affleck, Rosamund Pike and Neil Patrick Harris.

programme.title: The Professor & The Madman
programme.desc: Based on the best-selling novel by Simon Winchester, The Professor and the Madman is an extraordinary true tale of genius and obsession about two remarkable men - one an Oxford professor and the other, an inmate at Broadmoor Criminal Lunatic Asylum - who created history with the writing of the Oxford English Dictionary. Stars Mel Gibson, Sean Penn and Natalie Dormer.

programme.title: La Maison
programme.desc: 27-year-old French writer Emma immerses herself in Berlin's sex trade to research her novel. What begins as brief research becomes a two-year journey of desire, danger, and discovery.

programme.title: The Fence
programme.desc: Motorbikes, fast cars, punch-ups and 80's music. Set on the streets of 1980s Bristol, this retro flick follows a council estate kid out to settle the score with local thieves.

programme.title: The Silver Brumby
programme.desc: During a violent storm in the Victorian Highlands, a mother tells her frightened daughter a fable about a great silver brumby who must find its place among its kind, while one man, living in the wilderness, is determined to capture the brumby and tame it. Directed by John Tatoulis and stars Russell Crowe and Caroline Goodall.

programme.title: A River Runs Through It
programme.desc: The Maclean brothers, Paul (Brad Pitt) and Norman (Craig Sheffer), live a relatively idyllic life in rural Montana, spending much of their time fly fishing. The sons of a minister (Tom Skerritt), the boys eventually part company when Norman moves east to attend college, leaving his rebellious brother to find trouble back home. When Norman finally returns, the siblings resume their fishing outings, and assess both where they've been and where they're going.

programme.title: The Fisher King
programme.desc: Jeff Bridges stars as Jack Lucas, a former radio shock-jock who sinks into a boozy depression when his flip comment on the air is blamed for a shooting spree in an upscale cafe. Living off the kindness of long-suffering girlfriend Anne (Mercedes Ruehl), Jack has an epiphany when he is rescued from street punks by Parry (Robin Williams), a homeless former professor who has created a world of his own invention to insulate himself from the pain of witnessing his wife's death, in the cafe shooting spree. Directed by Terry Gilliam (Brazil).

programme.title: Only the Brave
programme.desc: Only the Brave tells the true story of the Granite Mountain Hotshots, a fearless team of firefighters who risk everything to protect others, forging a deep brotherhood tested by a deadly wildfire.

programme.title: The Ploughman's Lunch
programme.desc: James Penfield (Jonathan Pryce) has made a career out of journalism. Now bankrupt, he finds himself with a group of other writers in the middle of the dispute-ridden British homeland at the time of the Falklands War.

programme.title: The Amazing Mr. Blunden
programme.desc: In 1918, war widow Mrs. Allen and her children leave their cramped London flat to care for the derelict, allegedly haunted Langley Park, a country mansion awaiting its rightful heirs.

programme.title: Jumanji
programme.desc: Robin Williams and Kirsten Dunst star in this blockbuster hit and critical favourite that combines magical special effects with an entrancing mix of fantasy, adventure and comedy. Young Alan Parrish sits down as a young boy to play a game with his friend, Sarah, and on a roll of the dice is mysteriously transported into the strange jungle realm of Jumanji. There he remains trapped for 26 years, until two newly orphaned children, Judy (Dunst) and Peter (Bradley Pierce), playing in the attic of Alan’s childhood home, free the now-adult Alan (Williams) from the game’s clutches. But to defeat Jumanji’s encroaching powers, the three reluctant players must find the now-grown Sarah (Bonnie Hunt) and band together as a makeshift family to finish the game--before it finishes them.

programme.title: Gone Girl
programme.desc: On the occasion of his fifth wedding anniversary, Nick Dunne reports that his wife, Amy, has gone missing. Under pressure from the police and a growing media frenzy, Nick's portrait of a blissful union begins to crumble. Soon his lies, deceits and strange behaviour have everyone asking the same dark question: Did Nick Dunne kill his wife? Directed by David Fincher and stars Ben Affleck, Rosamund Pike and Neil Patrick Harris.

Beginning his journey in the Basque region of Spain, Will introduces his daughter Ellie to cheese maker Peio Etxeleku of Agour dairy. Peio shows off his new cheese facility in the Iraty Valley and discusses the many challenges now facing the regions traditional Cheesemakers.

programme.sub-title: Sausage Egg & Cheese All Day Long

Utilising the local produce, Luke cooks a pan seared Quail at Echoes Restaurant. He meets with the top chefs from the area and discovers their signature dishes.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail
programme.sub-title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail Series 1 Ep 4
programme.desc: On the sunshine coast of Australia, Luke meets with a local fisherman to learn about where his produce comes from and they go out netting for Spanner Crabs. Inspired by his newfound knowledge of Spanner Crabs, Luke mixes a Spanner crab with pomelo salad. Then, with the executive chef at the Spirit House, Luke cooks grilled kingfish with a Thai influence.

programme.sub-title: Maria Morgan: Ox Tail Stew & Vegie Bake
programme.desc: Marie Morgan draws on the Kimberley history of station and mission days. Marie shares with us a family recipe that takes us back to a simpler time.

programme.desc: Rachael puts an Italian spin on the classic French dip, marinating steak in bold Italian seasonings for a warm, comforting sandwich perfect for cooler days.

See the Macquarie River through the eyes of the people that know it best - First Nations peoples, historians, ecologists, water managers, farmers and fishers all with a story to tell.

programme.title: The Professor & The Madman
programme.desc: Based on the best-selling novel by Simon Winchester, The Professor and the Madman is an extraordinary true tale of genius and obsession about two remarkable men - one an Oxford professor and the other, an inmate at Broadmoor Criminal Lunatic Asylum - who created history with the writing of the Oxford English Dictionary. Stars Mel Gibson, Sean Penn and Natalie Dormer.

programme.title: La Maison
programme.desc: 27-year-old French writer Emma immerses herself in Berlin's sex trade to research her novel. What begins as brief research becomes a two-year journey of desire, danger, and discovery.

programme.title: The Fence
programme.desc: Motorbikes, fast cars, punch-ups and 80's music. Set on the streets of 1980s Bristol, this retro flick follows a council estate kid out to settle the score with local thieves.

programme.title: The Silver Brumby
programme.desc: During a violent storm in the Victorian Highlands, a mother tells her frightened daughter a fable about a great silver brumby who must find its place among its kind, while one man, living in the wilderness, is determined to capture the brumby and tame it. Directed by John Tatoulis and stars Russell Crowe and Caroline Goodall.

programme.title: A River Runs Through It
programme.desc: The Maclean brothers, Paul (Brad Pitt) and Norman (Craig Sheffer), live a relatively idyllic life in rural Montana, spending much of their time fly fishing. The sons of a minister (Tom Skerritt), the boys eventually part company when Norman moves east to attend college, leaving his rebellious brother to find trouble back home. When Norman finally returns, the siblings resume their fishing outings, and assess both where they've been and where they're going.

programme.title: The Fisher King
programme.desc: Jeff Bridges stars as Jack Lucas, a former radio shock-jock who sinks into a boozy depression when his flip comment on the air is blamed for a shooting spree in an upscale cafe. Living off the kindness of long-suffering girlfriend Anne (Mercedes Ruehl), Jack has an epiphany when he is rescued from street punks by Parry (Robin Williams), a homeless former professor who has created a world of his own invention to insulate himself from the pain of witnessing his wife's death, in the cafe shooting spree. Directed by Terry Gilliam (Brazil).

programme.title: Only the Brave
programme.desc: Only the Brave tells the true story of the Granite Mountain Hotshots, a fearless team of firefighters who risk everything to protect others, forging a deep brotherhood tested by a deadly wildfire.

programme.title: The Ploughman's Lunch
programme.desc: James Penfield (Jonathan Pryce) has made a career out of journalism. Now bankrupt, he finds himself with a group of other writers in the middle of the dispute-ridden British homeland at the time of the Falklands War.

programme.title: The Amazing Mr. Blunden
programme.desc: In 1918, war widow Mrs. Allen and her children leave their cramped London flat to care for the derelict, allegedly haunted Langley Park, a country mansion awaiting its rightful heirs.

programme.title: Jumanji
programme.desc: Robin Williams and Kirsten Dunst star in this blockbuster hit and critical favourite that combines magical special effects with an entrancing mix of fantasy, adventure and comedy. Young Alan Parrish sits down as a young boy to play a game with his friend, Sarah, and on a roll of the dice is mysteriously transported into the strange jungle realm of Jumanji. There he remains trapped for 26 years, until two newly orphaned children, Judy (Dunst) and Peter (Bradley Pierce), playing in the attic of Alan’s childhood home, free the now-adult Alan (Williams) from the game’s clutches. But to defeat Jumanji’s encroaching powers, the three reluctant players must find the now-grown Sarah (Bonnie Hunt) and band together as a makeshift family to finish the game--before it finishes them.

programme.title: Gone Girl
programme.desc: On the occasion of his fifth wedding anniversary, Nick Dunne reports that his wife, Amy, has gone missing. Under pressure from the police and a growing media frenzy, Nick's portrait of a blissful union begins to crumble. Soon his lies, deceits and strange behaviour have everyone asking the same dark question: Did Nick Dunne kill his wife? Directed by David Fincher and stars Ben Affleck, Rosamund Pike and Neil Patrick Harris.

Peio shows off his new cheese facility in the Iraty Valley and discusses the many challenges now facing the regions traditional Cheesemakers.

programme.title: The Professor & The Madman
programme.desc: Based on the best-selling novel by Simon Winchester, The Professor and the Madman is an extraordinary true tale of genius and obsession about two remarkable men - one an Oxford professor and the other, an inmate at Broadmoor Criminal Lunatic Asylum - who created history with the writing of the Oxford English Dictionary. Stars Mel Gibson, Sean Penn and Natalie Dormer.

programme.title: La Maison
programme.desc: 27-year-old French writer Emma immerses herself in Berlin's sex trade to research her novel. What begins as brief research becomes a two-year journey of desire, danger, and discovery.

programme.title: The Fence
programme.desc: Motorbikes, fast cars, punch-ups and 80's music. Set on the streets of 1980s Bristol, this retro flick follows a council estate kid out to settle the score with local thieves.

programme.title: The Silver Brumby
programme.desc: During a violent storm in the Victorian Highlands, a mother tells her frightened daughter a fable about a great silver brumby who must find its place among its kind, while one man, living in the wilderness, is determined to capture the brumby and tame it. Directed by John Tatoulis and stars Russell Crowe and Caroline Goodall.

programme.title: A River Runs Through It
programme.desc: The Maclean brothers, Paul (Brad Pitt) and Norman (Craig Sheffer), live a relatively idyllic life in rural Montana, spending much of their time fly fishing. The sons of a minister (Tom Skerritt), the boys eventually part company when Norman moves east to attend college, leaving his rebellious brother to find trouble back home. When Norman finally returns, the siblings resume their fishing outings, and assess both where they've been and where they're going.

programme.title: The Fisher King
programme.desc: Jeff Bridges stars as Jack Lucas, a former radio shock-jock who sinks into a boozy depression when his flip comment on the air is blamed for a shooting spree in an upscale cafe. Living off the kindness of long-suffering girlfriend Anne (Mercedes Ruehl), Jack has an epiphany when he is rescued from street punks by Parry (Robin Williams), a homeless former professor who has created a world of his own invention to insulate himself from the pain of witnessing his wife's death, in the cafe shooting spree. Directed by Terry Gilliam (Brazil).

programme.title: Only the Brave
programme.desc: Only the Brave tells the true story of the Granite Mountain Hotshots, a fearless team of firefighters who risk everything to protect others, forging a deep brotherhood tested by a deadly wildfire.

programme.title: The Ploughman's Lunch
programme.desc: James Penfield (Jonathan Pryce) has made a career out of journalism. Now bankrupt, he finds himself with a group of other writers in the middle of the dispute-ridden British homeland at the time of the Falklands War.

programme.title: The Amazing Mr. Blunden
programme.desc: In 1918, war widow Mrs. Allen and her children leave their cramped London flat to care for the derelict, allegedly haunted Langley Park, a country mansion awaiting its rightful heirs.

programme.title: Jumanji
programme.desc: Robin Williams and Kirsten Dunst star in this blockbuster hit and critical favourite that combines magical special effects with an entrancing mix of fantasy, adventure and comedy. Young Alan Parrish sits down as a young boy to play a game with his friend, Sarah, and on a roll of the dice is mysteriously transported into the strange jungle realm of Jumanji. There he remains trapped for 26 years, until two newly orphaned children, Judy (Dunst) and Peter (Bradley Pierce), playing in the attic of Alan’s childhood home, free the now-adult Alan (Williams) from the game’s clutches. But to defeat Jumanji’s encroaching powers, the three reluctant players must find the now-grown Sarah (Bonnie Hunt) and band together as a makeshift family to finish the game--before it finishes them.

programme.title: Gone Girl
programme.desc: On the occasion of his fifth wedding anniversary, Nick Dunne reports that his wife, Amy, has gone missing. Under pressure from the police and a growing media frenzy, Nick's portrait of a blissful union begins to crumble. Soon his lies, deceits and strange behaviour have everyone asking the same dark question: Did Nick Dunne kill his wife? Directed by David Fincher and stars Ben Affleck, Rosamund Pike and Neil Patrick Harris.

programme.title: The Little Death

Beginning his journey in the Basque region of Spain, Will introduces his daughter Ellie to cheese maker Peio Etxeleku of Agour dairy. Peio shows off his new cheese facility in the Iraty Valley and discusses the many challenges now facing the regions traditional Cheesemakers.

programme.sub-title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail Series 1 Ep 4

Inspired by his newfound knowledge of Spanner Crabs, Luke mixes a Spanner crab with pomelo salad. Then, with the executive chef at the Spirit House, Luke cooks grilled kingfish with a Thai influence.

programme.title: The Professor & The Madman
programme.desc: Based on the best-selling novel by Simon Winchester, The Professor and the Madman is an extraordinary true tale of genius and obsession about two remarkable men - one an Oxford professor and the other, an inmate at Broadmoor Criminal Lunatic Asylum - who created history with the writing of the Oxford English Dictionary. Stars Mel Gibson, Sean Penn and Natalie Dormer.

programme.title: La Maison
programme.desc: 27-year-old French writer Emma immerses herself in Berlin's sex trade to research her novel. What begins as brief research becomes a two-year journey of desire, danger, and discovery.

programme.title: The Fence
programme.desc: Motorbikes, fast cars, punch-ups and 80's music. Set on the streets of 1980s Bristol, this retro flick follows a council estate kid out to settle the score with local thieves.

programme.title: The Silver Brumby
programme.desc: During a violent storm in the Victorian Highlands, a mother tells her frightened daughter a fable about a great silver brumby who must find its place among its kind, while one man, living in the wilderness, is determined to capture the brumby and tame it. Directed by John Tatoulis and stars Russell Crowe and Caroline Goodall.

programme.title: A River Runs Through It
programme.desc: The Maclean brothers, Paul (Brad Pitt) and Norman (Craig Sheffer), live a relatively idyllic life in rural Montana, spending much of their time fly fishing. The sons of a minister (Tom Skerritt), the boys eventually part company when Norman moves east to attend college, leaving his rebellious brother to find trouble back home. When Norman finally returns, the siblings resume their fishing outings, and assess both where they've been and where they're going.

programme.title: The Fisher King
programme.desc: Jeff Bridges stars as Jack Lucas, a former radio shock-jock who sinks into a boozy depression when his flip comment on the air is blamed for a shooting spree in an upscale cafe. Living off the kindness of long-suffering girlfriend Anne (Mercedes Ruehl), Jack has an epiphany when he is rescued from street punks by Parry (Robin Williams), a homeless former professor who has created a world of his own invention to insulate himself from the pain of witnessing his wife's death, in the cafe shooting spree. Directed by Terry Gilliam (Brazil).

programme.title: Only the Brave
programme.desc: Only the Brave tells the true story of the Granite Mountain Hotshots, a fearless team of firefighters who risk everything to protect others, forging a deep brotherhood tested by a deadly wildfire.

programme.title: The Ploughman's Lunch
programme.desc: James Penfield (Jonathan Pryce) has made a career out of journalism. Now bankrupt, he finds himself with a group of other writers in the middle of the dispute-ridden British homeland at the time of the Falklands War.

programme.title: The Amazing Mr. Blunden
programme.desc: In 1918, war widow Mrs. Allen and her children leave their cramped London flat to care for the derelict, allegedly haunted Langley Park, a country mansion awaiting its rightful heirs.

programme.title: Jumanji
programme.desc: Robin Williams and Kirsten Dunst star in this blockbuster hit and critical favourite that combines magical special effects with an entrancing mix of fantasy, adventure and comedy. Young Alan Parrish sits down as a young boy to play a game with his friend, Sarah, and on a roll of the dice is mysteriously transported into the strange jungle realm of Jumanji. There he remains trapped for 26 years, until two newly orphaned children, Judy (Dunst) and Peter (Bradley Pierce), playing in the attic of Alan’s childhood home, free the now-adult Alan (Williams) from the game’s clutches. But to defeat Jumanji’s encroaching powers, the three reluctant players must find the now-grown Sarah (Bonnie Hunt) and band together as a makeshift family to finish the game--before it finishes them.

programme.title: Gone Girl
programme.desc: On the occasion of his fifth wedding anniversary, Nick Dunne reports that his wife, Amy, has gone missing. Under pressure from the police and a growing media frenzy, Nick's portrait of a blissful union begins to crumble. Soon his lies, deceits and strange behaviour have everyone asking the same dark question: Did Nick Dunne kill his wife? Directed by David Fincher and stars Ben Affleck, Rosamund Pike and Neil Patrick Harris.

Beginning his journey in the Basque region of Spain, Will introduces his daughter Ellie to cheese maker Peio Etxeleku of Agour dairy. Peio shows off his new cheese facility in the Iraty Valley and discusses the many challenges now facing the regions traditional Cheesemakers.

Utilising the local produce, Luke cooks a pan seared Quail at Echoes Restaurant. He meets with the top chefs from the area and discovers their signature dishes.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail
programme.sub-title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail Series 1 Ep 4
programme.desc: On the sunshine coast of Australia, Luke meets with a local fisherman to learn about where his produce comes from and they go out netting for Spanner Crabs. Inspired by his newfound knowledge of Spanner Crabs, Luke mixes a Spanner crab with pomelo salad. Then, with the executive chef at the Spirit House, Luke cooks grilled kingfish with a Thai influence.

Exploring the eating habits of these cities is the start of a fascinating trip for Rick who is inspired to cook dishes like prawns in coconut milk and his mum's version of British Raj curry.

See the Macquarie River through the eyes of the people that know it best - First Nations peoples, historians, ecologists, water managers, farmers and fishers all with a story to tell.

programme.desc: Based on the best-selling novel by Simon Winchester, The Professor and the Madman is an extraordinary true tale of genius and obsession about two remarkable men - one an Oxford professor and the other, an inmate at Broadmoor Criminal Lunatic Asylum - who created history with the writing of the Oxford English Dictionary. Stars Mel Gibson, Sean Penn and Natalie Dormer.

programme.title: La Maison
programme.desc: 27-year-old French writer Emma immerses herself in Berlin's sex trade to research her novel. What begins as brief research becomes a two-year journey of desire, danger, and discovery.

programme.title: The Fence
programme.desc: Motorbikes, fast cars, punch-ups and 80's music. Set on the streets of 1980s Bristol, this retro flick follows a council estate kid out to settle the score with local thieves.

programme.title: The Silver Brumby
programme.desc: During a violent storm in the Victorian Highlands, a mother tells her frightened daughter a fable about a great silver brumby who must find its place among its kind, while one man, living in the wilderness, is determined to capture the brumby and tame it. Directed by John Tatoulis and stars Russell Crowe and Caroline Goodall.

programme.title: A River Runs Through It
programme.desc: The Maclean brothers, Paul (Brad Pitt) and Norman (Craig Sheffer), live a relatively idyllic life in rural Montana, spending much of their time fly fishing. The sons of a minister (Tom Skerritt), the boys eventually part company when Norman moves east to attend college, leaving his rebellious brother to find trouble back home. When Norman finally returns, the siblings resume their fishing outings, and assess both where they've been and where they're going.

programme.title: The Fisher King
programme.desc: Jeff Bridges stars as Jack Lucas, a former radio shock-jock who sinks into a boozy depression when his flip comment on the air is blamed for a shooting spree in an upscale cafe. Living off the kindness of long-suffering girlfriend Anne (Mercedes Ruehl), Jack has an epiphany when he is rescued from street punks by Parry (Robin Williams), a homeless former professor who has created a world of his own invention to insulate himself from the pain of witnessing his wife's death, in the cafe shooting spree. Directed by Terry Gilliam (Brazil).

programme.title: Only the Brave
programme.desc: Only the Brave tells the true story of the Granite Mountain Hotshots, a fearless team of firefighters who risk everything to protect others, forging a deep brotherhood tested by a deadly wildfire.

programme.title: The Ploughman's Lunch
programme.desc: James Penfield (Jonathan Pryce) has made a career out of journalism. Now bankrupt, he finds himself with a group of other writers in the middle of the dispute-ridden British homeland at the time of the Falklands War.

programme.title: The Amazing Mr. Blunden
programme.desc: In 1918, war widow Mrs. Allen and her children leave their cramped London flat to care for the derelict, allegedly haunted Langley Park, a country mansion awaiting its rightful heirs.

programme.title: Jumanji
programme.desc: Robin Williams and Kirsten Dunst star in this blockbuster hit and critical favourite that combines magical special effects with an entrancing mix of fantasy, adventure and comedy. Young Alan Parrish sits down as a young boy to play a game with his friend, Sarah, and on a roll of the dice is mysteriously transported into the strange jungle realm of Jumanji. There he remains trapped for 26 years, until two newly orphaned children, Judy (Dunst) and Peter (Bradley Pierce), playing in the attic of Alan’s childhood home, free the now-adult Alan (Williams) from the game’s clutches. But to defeat Jumanji’s encroaching powers, the three reluctant players must find the now-grown Sarah (Bonnie Hunt) and band together as a makeshift family to finish the game--before it finishes them.

programme.title: Gone Girl
programme.desc: On the occasion of his fifth wedding anniversary, Nick Dunne reports that his wife, Amy, has gone missing. Under pressure from the police and a growing media frenzy, Nick's portrait of a blissful union begins to crumble. Soon his lies, deceits and strange behaviour have everyone asking the same dark question: Did Nick Dunne kill his wife? Directed by David Fincher and stars Ben Affleck, Rosamund Pike and Neil Patrick Harris.

programme.title: The Professor & The Madman
programme.desc: Based on the best-selling novel by Simon Winchester, The Professor and the Madman is an extraordinary true tale of genius and obsession about two remarkable men - one an Oxford professor and the other, an inmate at Broadmoor Criminal Lunatic Asylum - who created history with the writing of the Oxford English Dictionary. Stars Mel Gibson, Sean Penn and Natalie Dormer.

programme.title: La Maison
programme.desc: 27-year-old French writer Emma immerses herself in Berlin's sex trade to research her novel. What begins as brief research becomes a two-year journey of desire, danger, and discovery.

programme.title: The Fence
programme.desc: Motorbikes, fast cars, punch-ups and 80's music. Set on the streets of 1980s Bristol, this retro flick follows a council estate kid out to settle the score with local thieves.

programme.title: The Silver Brumby
programme.desc: During a violent storm in the Victorian Highlands, a mother tells her frightened daughter a fable about a great silver brumby who must find its place among its kind, while one man, living in the wilderness, is determined to capture the brumby and tame it. Directed by John Tatoulis and stars Russell Crowe and Caroline Goodall.

programme.title: A River Runs Through It
programme.desc: The Maclean brothers, Paul (Brad Pitt) and Norman (Craig Sheffer), live a relatively idyllic life in rural Montana, spending much of their time fly fishing. The sons of a minister (Tom Skerritt), the boys eventually part company when Norman moves east to attend college, leaving his rebellious brother to find trouble back home. When Norman finally returns, the siblings resume their fishing outings, and assess both where they've been and where they're going.

programme.title: The Fisher King
programme.desc: Jeff Bridges stars as Jack Lucas, a former radio shock-jock who sinks into a boozy depression when his flip comment on the air is blamed for a shooting spree in an upscale cafe. Living off the kindness of long-suffering girlfriend Anne (Mercedes Ruehl), Jack has an epiphany when he is rescued from street punks by Parry (Robin Williams), a homeless former professor who has created a world of his own invention to insulate himself from the pain of witnessing his wife's death, in the cafe shooting spree. Directed by Terry Gilliam (Brazil).

programme.title: Only the Brave
programme.desc: Only the Brave tells the true story of the Granite Mountain Hotshots, a fearless team of firefighters who risk everything to protect others, forging a deep brotherhood tested by a deadly wildfire.

programme.title: The Ploughman's Lunch
programme.desc: James Penfield (Jonathan Pryce) has made a career out of journalism. Now bankrupt, he finds himself with a group of other writers in the middle of the dispute-ridden British homeland at the time of the Falklands War.

programme.title: The Amazing Mr. Blunden
programme.desc: In 1918, war widow Mrs. Allen and her children leave their cramped London flat to care for the derelict, allegedly haunted Langley Park, a country mansion awaiting its rightful heirs.

programme.title: Jumanji
programme.desc: Robin Williams and Kirsten Dunst star in this blockbuster hit and critical favourite that combines magical special effects with an entrancing mix of fantasy, adventure and comedy. Young Alan Parrish sits down as a young boy to play a game with his friend, Sarah, and on a roll of the dice is mysteriously transported into the strange jungle realm of Jumanji. There he remains trapped for 26 years, until two newly orphaned children, Judy (Dunst) and Peter (Bradley Pierce), playing in the attic of Alan’s childhood home, free the now-adult Alan (Williams) from the game’s clutches. But to defeat Jumanji’s encroaching powers, the three reluctant players must find the now-grown Sarah (Bonnie Hunt) and band together as a makeshift family to finish the game--before it finishes them.

programme.title: Gone Girl
programme.desc: On the occasion of his fifth wedding anniversary, Nick Dunne reports that his wife, Amy, has gone missing. Under pressure from the police and a growing media frenzy, Nick's portrait of a blissful union begins to crumble. Soon his lies, deceits and strange behaviour have everyone asking the same dark question: Did Nick Dunne kill his wife? Directed by David Fincher and stars Ben Affleck, Rosamund Pike and Neil Patrick Harris.

programme.title: The Little Death
programme.desc: Unfulfilled suburban couples try to spice up their sex lives by exploring various fetishes.

programme.title: Destination Flavour Scandinavia Bitesize
programme.sub-title: Destination Flavour Scandinavia Bitesize Series 1 Ep 5
programme.desc: Join Adam Liaw as he revisits the highlights from his Scandinavian food adventures.

programme.title: No Taste Like Home
programme.desc: Awkwafina lost her mom when she was very young. Antoni curates a culinary voyage of discovery to help her reconnect with her mother's Korean heritage.

programme.title: La Dolce Vita
programme.desc: Master pastry chefs Paco and Jacob Torreblanca travel around Spain, a country where sweets have been closely linked to religious festivities.

programme.title: Come Dine With Me UK

programme.title: Come Dine With Me UK
programme.desc: This week's competition is in Bedford & Cambridgeshire, where first to host is teaching assistant Michelle.

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programme.desc: What pasta recipes do Adam and his guests, pastry prince Adriano Zumbo and comedy queen Alex Ward, come back to again and again? Find out as they make their forever pastas.

programme.title: Cheese Slices
programme.desc: After more than a decade, Will Studd returns to the Pyrenees Mountains, home to some of the world's oldest shepherd's cheeses and one of the last strongholds of traditional artisan cheese making in Western Europe. Beginning his journey in the Basque region of Spain, Will introduces his daughter Ellie to cheese maker Peio Etxeleku of Agour dairy. Peio shows off his new cheese facility in the Iraty Valley and discusses the many challenges now facing the regions traditional Cheesemakers.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.sub-title: Sausage Egg & Cheese All Day Long
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde brings out the best of brunch with sweet and savoury hits such as bacon wrapped dates stuffed with chorizo, maple sausage, egg, and cheese fried rice and BBQ duck, egg, and corn scallion pancake sandwiches.

programme.title: Flat Out Food
programme.desc: Jenn learns how ethically sourced coffee makes its way to Saskatchewan and explores the processes of roasting, cupping, and using coffee beyond brewing the perfect cup of joe.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail
programme.sub-title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail Series 1 Ep 3
programme.desc: Escaping the hustle and bustle of Sydney, Luke visits the Blue Mountains in New South Wales. Overlooking the majestic ranges, Luke cooks seared Lamb Cutlets with an Asian Salsa Verde, and meets up with his old friend Huong to have an Eastern high tea. Utilising the local produce, Luke cooks a pan seared Quail at Echoes Restaurant. He meets with the top chefs from the area and discovers their signature dishes.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail
programme.sub-title: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail Series 1 Ep 4
programme.desc: On the sunshine coast of Australia, Luke meets with a local fisherman to learn about where his produce comes from and they go out netting for Spanner Crabs. Inspired by his newfound knowledge of Spanner Crabs, Luke mixes a Spanner crab with pomelo salad. Then, with the executive chef at the Spirit House, Luke cooks grilled kingfish with a Thai influence.

programme.title: Kriol Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Maria Morgan: Ox Tail Stew & Vegie Bake
programme.desc: Marie Morgan draws on the Kimberley history of station and mission days. Marie shares with us a family recipe that takes us back to a simpler time.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.desc: Rachael puts an Italian spin on the classic French dip, marinating steak in bold Italian seasonings for a warm, comforting sandwich perfect for cooler days.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: Laura is joined in the Market Kitchen by vegetable farmer Catherine Velisha as they pickle celery, probably the most underrated pickle. Mike then cooks a beautiful vegetarian dish, Fried Tofu with Bang Bang Sauce, an ideal mid-week meal. To wrap the show, Laura makes and shares her popular Sausage Rolls.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: It's important to Lidia to be inclusive at the dinner table, and cook dishes that meet the dietary restrictions of all- from vegetarian to gluten-free.

programme.desc: The incredible chef and world class restaurateur behind the three Michelin star Le Bernardin restaurant in New York, Eric Ripert, is cooking at the barn and sharing career highs, childhood lows and life-changing stories.

programme.title: Freshly Picked
programme.desc: First up, Simon wraps tabbouleh with tempeh for toothsome flavours and then bakes an avocado that's cheesy and creamy. Rebecca Veale from Humble Jumble is also in the kitchen today to make her famous sticky date pudding.

programme.title: Food Safari Earth
programme.desc: Maeve explores the sweet power of onions with Spanish chef, Pablo Tordesillas Garcia and discovers the delights of a Catalonian favourite - char-grilled baby leeks with romesco sauce. Sicilian-Australian chef, Rosa Mitchell recalls a symphony of recipes from her heritage in her Melbourne restaurant, Rosa's Canteen - and shares her version of caponata - a sweet-sour vegetable dish that epitomises what the Italians refer to as 'agrodolce'.

programme.title: Hairy Bikers Go West
programme.desc: The Hairy Bikers are back on the road searching for wonderful seasonal ingredients to create a festive banquet to thank all those who've helped Dave throughout his recent struggles.

programme.desc: Franco Noriega recreates his Italian grandmother's favorite dishes! A Prosciutto Flatbread Pizza with melty caramelized onions and sweet balsamic vinegar glaze is the perfect appetizer.

programme.desc: Jenn meets Robyn and Josh, who grow produce in tunnels, to learn how sage is cultivated in a northern climate.
